name: Koi no Owari
source:
Main character is in love with his classmate. But one day he peeks through the wall and finds the object of his love in dubious relations with an adult man...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角爱上了同班同学。然而，某天，他透过墙上的缝隙偷看时，却发现心上人与一名成年男子有着不可告人的关系……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
